# Baseline comparison: evarb vs legacy labels, TEA and the LLM evidence arbiter

**16 November 2026.** Component level (the arbitration decision on one group of records, no agent). Generated by `scripts/component_report.py` from the frozen scorer `component_eval.score`; full tables in `data/BASELINE_*.md|json`. Agent-level comparison: **not yet run** (`PHASE2_STATUS.md` §2).

## 0. How to read this

| Split | Role | What a good evarb number means |
|---|---|---|
| dev (114) + regression (46) | **tuned on** | the behaviour is implemented; nothing more |
| p2val (77 valid, 70 needing arbitration) | looked at once with evarb-0.1, then evarb-0.2 was revised on what it showed → **development** | an upper bound; evarb-0.2's p2val numbers are post hoc |
| p2val2 | untouched validation for the frozen evarb-0.2 | **not available yet** (Slurm 4199 pending) |
| eval3 | Phase 3 confirmatory | sealed, not built yet |

Methods: **legacy** = memlab's `recorded_on`-only labels (configs G, R); **TEA** = Phase 1 arbiter (T, RT); **evarb** = frozen evarb-0.2 (EB, EBG); **LLM arbiter** = same output schema filled by an LLM, one row per model, greedy (job 4189; LA, LG use the agent's own model).

Error definitions (`component_eval.py`): false resolution = gold has no current value but the method picks one; enforceable error = an error made with `strong` strength (the gated policy would act on it).

## 2. p2val (independent writer; development since the evarb-0.2 revision)

Gold is the **v1 skeleton gold**. Under v1, negated replacements and quoted claims were labelled `conflict`; the v2 semantics adopted after the blind annotation keep the established value instead. Three subsets:

| Method | all 70 (v1 gold) | current-intent 63 | annotator-agreed current 52 | false resolutions (all / agreed) | enforceable errors (all / agreed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy | 35 | 35 | 24 | 4 / 4 | 35 / 28 |
| TEA | 34 | 34 | 30 | 7 / 0 | 36 / 22 |
| **evarb-0.2** | **56** | **56** | **52** | 7 / **0** | 6 / **0** |
| LLM Qwen2.5-3B | 27 | 27 | 20 | 7 / 3 | 15 / 8 |
| LLM Qwen2.5-7B | 35 | 35 | 35 | 18 / 7 | 31 / 15 |
| LLM Llama-3.1-8B | 25 | 24 | 23 | 24 / 14 | 39 / 23 |
| LLM Qwen2.5-14B | 39 | 39 | 38 | 14 / 4 | 23 / 9 |

Paired evarb − baseline, proportion correct, family bootstrap 95% CI, sign-flip p, Holm over the 6 baselines (all-70 subset):

| Contrast | diff | 95% CI | p (Holm) |
|---|---|---|---|
| evarb − legacy | +0.300 | +0.143 to +0.443 | 0.0005 |
| evarb − TEA | +0.314 | +0.200 to +0.429 | 0.0001 |
| evarb − LLM Qwen2.5-14B (best LLM) | +0.243 | +0.143 to +0.343 | 0.0001 |
| evarb − LLM Qwen2.5-7B | +0.300 | +0.186 to +0.400 | 0.0001 |
| evarb − LLM Llama-3.1-8B | +0.443 | +0.314 to +0.571 | 0.0001 |
| evarb − LLM Qwen2.5-3B | +0.414 | +0.271 to +0.543 | 0.0001 |

**Where evarb-0.2 is wrong on p2val (all 70):**
- 7 false resolutions: the 4 `negated_replacement` and 3 `quoted_claim` items, where v1 gold says `conflict` and evarb-0.2 keeps the established value by design (v2). The blind annotator disagreed with the v1 gold on these, which is why the semantics changed.
- 7 incorrect supersessions: the 4 `as_of_question` and 3 `historical_question` items. Every method scores 0 on them, because component scoring asks for the current value and historical intent is handled by the agent loop. They are excluded in the current-intent subset.
- 6 enforceable errors, all on historical / as-of items (the strong current-value resolution is "wrong" only because component scoring ignores intent; at agent level the policy never enforces on a historical question, `test_stale_answer_on_historical_question_not_enforced`). The 7 negated/quoted false resolutions are all `moderate`, so the gated policy would only advise on them. On current-intent items evarb-0.2 has **0** enforceable errors.

**Annotation of p2val** (blind, labels from text only; `data/p2val/p2val_AGREEMENT_3ann.json`): agreement with the skeleton gold, 77 items: Llama-3.1-8B 52/77 (κ 0.49), Qwen2.5-14B 55/77 (κ 0.52), Claude Opus (earlier session) 67/77 (κ 0.73). All three agree with gold on 39/77. The two open-weight annotators are weak; model agreement is **not** human ground truth.

**What p2val supports.** On text written by a model that never saw the mechanism, the deterministic arbiter beats every baseline by 24–44 pp with no false resolution on items where an annotator confirmed the gold. **What it does not support:** an unbiased accuracy for evarb-0.2, because 0.2 was revised after seeing p2val. That number must come from p2val2 (component and agent level) and, confirmatorily, eval3.

## 3. Cost of the LLM arbiter

Per group, greedy, one L40 (job 4189, p2val groups): Qwen2.5-3B 0.70 s / 476 tokens; Qwen2.5-7B 1.19 s / 478; Llama-3.1-8B 1.34 s / 473; Qwen2.5-14B 2.76 s / 489. Format failures: 1/230 groups for Qwen2.5-7B, 1/230 for Qwen2.5-14B (counted as unresolved). evarb is a deterministic function: < 1 ms per group, no tokens.

## 4. p2val2 — validation of the frozen evarb-0.2 (component level)

Built after the freeze (Slurm job 4199, 16 Nov), never used for tuning. 92 skeleton items, **90 valid**, 82 need arbitration (74 with current intent). Item audit and primary-rule decision were written and hashed **before** any output below was opened (`data/p2val2/PRE_OUTCOME_HASHES.txt`). Gold uses the v2 semantics. Tables: `data/BASELINE_p2val2*.md|json`.

| Method | all 82 | current-intent 74 | double-agreed 40 | Qwen-agreed 59 | audit-sensitivity 70 | false resolutions (74) | enforceable errors (74) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy | 35 | 35 | 23 | 29 | 33 | 4 | 39 |
| TEA | 37 | 37 | 23 | 30 | 35 | 4 | 37 |
| **evarb-0.2** | **69** | **69** | **38** | **57** | **65** | 4 | **1** |
| LLM Qwen2.5-3B | 30 | 30 | 19 | 23 | 29 | 2 | 8 |
| LLM Qwen2.5-7B | 41 | 41 | 26 | 34 | 41 | 15 | 24 |
| LLM Llama-3.1-8B | 27 | 26 | 16 | 22 | 26 | 25 | 39 |
| LLM Qwen2.5-14B | 48 | 47 | 31 | 39 | 46 | 8 | 15 |

(The last three subset columns are current-intent items intersected with the subset.)

Paired evarb − baseline on the 74 current-intent items (family bootstrap 95% CI; Holm over 6): legacy **+0.46** [0.32, 0.59]; TEA **+0.43** [0.32, 0.55]; LLM Qwen2.5-14B **+0.30** [0.18, 0.42]; LLM Qwen2.5-7B +0.38; LLM Qwen2.5-3B +0.53; LLM Llama-3.1-8B +0.58; every Holm p ≤ 0.0001. On the most conservative subset (double-agreed, 40 items) evarb − LLM Qwen2.5-14B is +0.18 [0.08, 0.30], Holm p = 0.016.

**evarb-0.2's errors on p2val2 (current intent: 5 of 74):**
- **`negated_both_stand`: 0/4.** "…does not replace X. Both figures stand until they are reconciled" resolves to X (moderate, advisory, never enforced). Cause: the contradiction marker is detected, but the 0.2 rule that sets aside a record whose own value appears only inside a negated replacement ignores it. This category was added with the v2 skeleton and had no development fixture of exactly this form. **A genuine validation failure of the frozen version.**
- **p2val2-0005:** "correcting the cloud region to south-delta-3" — `correcting` is not in the correction cue list, so the same-day pair is a **strong** genuine contradiction: the one **enforceable** error (the gated policy would push a correct answer toward `conflict`).
- Both are pinned in `tests/test_known_limitations.py` and listed in `PREREGISTRATION.md` §12. evarb-0.2 is **not** changed.
- The 8 historical / as-of items are component-scoring artefacts (intent is handled in the loop), as on p2val.

**What p2val2 supports:** on independently written text the frozen arbiter is far more accurate than legacy labels, TEA and LLM arbiters up to 14B, with almost no enforceable errors. It does **not** yet show agent-level benefit; that is the next step.

## 6. Update 17 November: agent level on p2val2 (jobs 4213, 4222)

Reconciliation of 69/74 vs 69/82: p2val2 has 90 valid items; **82** need arbitration (the other 8 are single-record controls). Of the 82, 74 ask for the *current* value; the 8 `as_of_question`/`historical_question` items are scored by the component scorer as wrong for every method (0/8 each), because it asks for the current value and historical intent is handled in the agent loop. So evarb-0.2 is 69/82 on all arbitrated items and 69/74 on current-intent items (same 69 correct; only the denominator differs). Scoring rule: `component_eval.score`, correct = resolved status and value equal gold.

Agent-level results, greedy, 90 items, 4 models: `data/AGENT_p2val2.md` (all valid) and `data/AGENT_p2val2_primary.md` (51 double-agreed items; sensitivity). Pooled EBG−RT +15.8 pp [9.2, 22.8]; per model +10.0, +24.4, +27.8 and +1.1 (Llama-3.1-8B). EBG−LG +13.1; EBG−T +12.5; EBG−B +18.6. Ungated enforcement (EBG-all) scored higher than EBG on p2val2 (243 vs 218 of 360) with more harmful answers (29 vs 14). Llama-3.1-8B: 9 format failures and heavy abstention under every configuration.
